cases.title: a public raster game exposes its identity and host action before artwork, preserving original downloads and invite entry
long titles and absent, landscape or failed covers keep the entry usable across narrow, short and desktop layouts
detail hosting keeps Close and Create table usable at short height and preserves the game through sign-in dismissal
hosting keeps keyboard focus in the dialog and restores it after Escape
hosting hands focus to the invite and keeps the current app origin
the host dialog does not intercept Escape from the separate sign-in overlay

scope: Only game-detail and host-dialog E2E files; local isolated D1/R2/Room and fixed Worker compilation; no external provider requests are required.
